          Eh… what’s up, doc?
        
      
    

    
    
      01 / SUMMARY

      
        A littleabout me.

        
          
            I’m Neha Bari Tamboli. My work brings together data
            engineering, analysis, and machine learning, with
            industry projects across energy, healthcare, and
            restaurant digitalization.
          
          
            Through projects with TU Eindhoven, Enexis, and Philips,
            I’ve worked on preparing datasets, checking data quality,
            developing predictive models, and translating stakeholder
            requirements into technical work.
          
          
            My earlier experience at Tata Consultancy Services,
            supporting Morgan Stanley’s batch operations, also
            introduced me to the practical demands of production
            systems and reliable execution.
          
          
            Below is a closer look at the problems I worked on,
            what I contributed, and the results.
          
        
      
    

    
    
  
    
      02 / PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
      The problem.My approach. The result.
    
    
      A closer look at my work, from preparing reliable data
      to evaluating models and communicating findings.
    
  

  

    
    
      TU EINDHOVEN · 2025–2026
      Restaurant Digitalization
      EngD industry project

      
        How can restaurant and customer needs inform an AI
        ordering assistant—and how can its data support
        order completion prediction?
      

      
        0.79
        Approximate ROC AUC for order completion prediction
      

      My contribution
      
        Gathered input from four restaurants and 65 customers,
        translating the findings into 35 prioritized requirements.
        Built a scheduled Databricks workflow to validate
        221 simulated customer sessions.
      

      
        Session data
        →
        Validation
        →
        Delta Lake
        →
        Prediction
      

      
        Read about my approach

        
          Checking the data
          
            Checked sessions for missing, duplicate, and invalid
            records. Stored validated data in Delta Lake and
            prepared structured datasets for modeling.
          

          Testing the experience
          
            Developed and A/B tested ordering interface variants,
            using SQL to analyze order completion rates.
          

          Developing the models
          
            Developed Logistic Regression and XGBoost models
            to predict order completion, achieving approximately
            0.79 ROC AUC.
          
          
            ROC AUC measures how well a model distinguishes
            completed orders from incomplete orders across
            classification thresholds. It is not the same
            as percentage accuracy.
          

          Data context
          
            The validation workflow covered 221 simulated sessions.
            I also worked with data stewards on responsible
            handling of customer and restaurant data.
          
        
      

      
        Python · SQL · Azure Databricks · Delta Lake · XGBoost
      
    

    
    
      ENEXIS · 2024
      Electricity Forecasting
      EngD industry project

      
        Preparing electricity load records and time-based features
        for infeed and grid loss forecasting.
      

      
        7.63%
        MAPE for the GRU forecasting model
      

      My contribution
      
        Developed PySpark processing workflows in Azure Databricks
        and engineered lag, rolling average, and calendar features
        for downstream forecasting.
      

      
        Load records
        →
        Transformation
        →
        Feature tables
        →
        GRU model
      

      
        Read about my approach

        
          Understanding the requirements
          
            Collaborated with a lead Data Scientist to understand
            the supplied datasets and clarify business requirements.
          

          Preparing forecasting features
          
            Used PySpark window functions to create lag features,
            rolling averages, and calendar features. Prepared
            the resulting data as Databricks feature tables.
          

          Training and results
          
            Used chronological training for a GRU model,
            achieving 7.63% mean absolute percentage error.
            MAPE expresses forecast error relative to actual values.
          

          Processing performance
          
            The data processing workflow ran in 1 minute and
            2 seconds in the development environment. This is
            a development runtime, rather than a production benchmark.
          
        
      

      
        PySpark · Azure Databricks · Feature Engineering · GRU
      
    

    
    
      PHILIPS · 2024–2025
      Digital Pathology
      EngD industry project · Project manager

      
        Assessing the data needed to support intelligent assignment
        of pathology cases to pathologists.
      

      
        11
        Data quality gaps documented and prioritized
      

      My contribution
      
        Managed an Agile project with Philips’ Pathology team.
        Assessed schemas, aligned open-source datasets with business
        definitions, and communicated the implications of data gaps.
      

      
        Schema review
        →
        Gap assessment
        →
        Data alignment
        →
        Recommendations
      

      
        Read about my approach

        
          Assessing readiness
          
            Reviewed database schemas and data models with
            the Pathology team, documenting six high-priority
            and five medium-priority data quality gaps.
          

          Aligning definitions
          
            Integrated open-source datasets into Philips’ schema,
            aligning case, pathologist, and tissue attributes
            with consistent business definitions.
          

          Making the findings useful
          
            Explained to nontechnical stakeholders why the gaps
            mattered and which attributes a model trained on
            open-source data relied on for case assignment.
          

          The outcome
          
            Delivered a prioritized assessment and stakeholder
            recommendations about the data needed for modeling.
          
        
      

      
        Data Quality · Data Modeling · Agile · Stakeholder Communication
      
    

    
    
      INNO4HEALTH · 2024
      AFib Detection on ECG
      EngD industry project

      
        Processed single-lead ECG recordings into 30-second windows
        and extracted time-domain features, identifying 21 features
        relevant to AFib detection.
      
      
        Worked in a five-person Agile team and discussed findings
        with stakeholders during weekly reviews.
      

      
        ECG Analysis · Feature Extraction · Agile
      
    

    
      KNSB · ALLIANDER · OMRON · 2024
      Industry Collaborations
      EngD industry projects

      Omron
      
        Analyzed 42 stitching-machine sensor signals to identify
        equipment fault indicators for predictive maintenance.
      

      Alliander
      
        Clustered 30,000 customer records into eight load-profile
        segments to estimate power requirements for new customers.
      

      KNSB
      
        Led a team analyzing over 500,000 skating records,
        segmenting athletes by age and venue to compare engagement.
      

      
        Data Analysis · Clustering · Team Leadership
      
    

    
      TATA CONSULTANCY SERVICES · 2016–2018
      Software Developer
      Client: Morgan Stanley

      
        Supported production batch job migrations across regions,
        monitored execution against SLA windows, and reported
        failed or delayed runs.
      

      
        Production Support · Batch Operations · SLA Monitoring
      
    
  

  
    ASK ABOUT MY WORK ↗
